planned_by: Claude (Critic): evolution /run vs 300 s proxy; signed-proof UI
goal:
T31 — evolution runs in the background, the web polls it, and /verify shows real signature status.

Problem: POST /v1/evolution/{id}/run loops generations inside the HTTP request; through the web proxy (Cloud Run 300 s)
any real run times out. And /verify must say whether a certificate is Ed25519-signed (T27 added cert.signed,
cert.algorithm, cert.public_key and GET /v1/proof/key).

1. services/api/main.py:
   - POST /v1/evolution/{id}/run: 404 unknown; if a background run is already active for it -> 409; if the evolution is
     terminal -> return 200 with its current public view (no new run); otherwise start a daemon thread and return 202
     {evolution_id, status, run_active: true} immediately. The worker repeatedly calls the module-level
     `_evolution_step_locked(evolution_id)` under the same per-evolution lock as /step until the evolution is no longer
     RUNNING; on an exception it stops and records run_error (type + message, max 300 chars, never code).
   - POST /v1/evolution/{id}/step while a background run is active -> 409.
   - GET /v1/evolution and GET /v1/evolution/{id} include "run_active" (bool) and "run_error" (str|null).
   - The per-evolution worst-case budget check from T27 stays in /start.
2. apps/web/app/[locale]/evolution/page.tsx: "run" calls POST .../run, then polls GET /v1/evolution/{id} every 3 s
   (setInterval/setTimeout) while run_active or status RUNNING, updating the generation timeline live; shows run_error.
3. apps/web/app/[locale]/verify/[id]/page.tsx: show "Ed25519 signed" with a short public-key fingerprint (first 16 chars)
   when cert.signed is true, a clear "Unsigned — signing not configured" state when false; fetch the server key from
   GET /v1/proof/key (add getProofKey() to apps/web/lib/api.ts) and show whether cert.public_key matches it.
4. New strings in messages/ko.json and messages/en.json (identical key sets), including "Ed25519" and an unsigned text.
5. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t31.py. Keep all existing tests green.
